description: This source file defines an Android activity class 'OnboardingActivity' which manages the onboarding screen for a Tic Tac Toe game. It handles UI initialization, player icon selection, and navigation to the main game activity.

classes.name: OnboardingActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing the onboarding UI, allowing players to select their game icons before starting the match.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the onboarding screen, sets up UI elements, and manages the start button enabled state based on user selections.

methods.name: getSelectedIcon
methods.description: Retrieves the icon chosen by a player from their radio button group.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Dynamically retrieves layout resource identifier by name.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Dynamically retrieves view ID resource identifier by name.
